description: Defines a class 'DrupalHtmlBuilder' that converts document fragments into HTML strings, handling escaping of special characters and managing HTML element serialization.

classes.name: DrupalHtmlBuilder
classes.description: A class for converting document fragments into HTML strings with proper escaping and handling of raw tags.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns the current HTML string built from document fragments.

methods.name: appendNode
methods.description: Converts a document fragment into an HTML string and appends it to the internal chunks.

methods.name: _appendElement
methods.description: Appends an element node to the HTML output, handling self-closing tags.

methods.name: _appendChildren
methods.description: Appends child nodes of a given node to the output.

methods.name: _appendAttributes
methods.description: Appends attributes of a node to the output, escaping attribute values.

methods.name: _appendText
methods.description: Appends text content, handling raw tags and encoding entities.

methods.name: _appendComment
methods.description: Appends a comment node to the output.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a string to the internal chunks array.

methods.name: _escapeAttribute
methods.description: Escapes special characters in attribute values for safe HTML output.
